description: Scenario where the scheduled run finds no overdue or at-risk work items. The Airtable search returns zero results. The scenario should exit silently at the Filter module without sending any notifications or making any state changes.

trigger_context.note: Scheduled run at 03:00 (quiet period). No work items are overdue or approaching SLA breach.

expected_behaviour.note: Only 2 operations consumed: schedule trigger + Airtable search. This is the expected behaviour for quiet periods.
